items.title: Show HN: Evoboard – GitHub style habit heatmaps with automatic activity logging
items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN!
I built evoboard, a web app which shows your consistency on a year long heatmap.
I liked the contribution graphs on GitHub and LeetCode, and wondered if I could make that idea for my everyday habits. I also made it so the habits can be completed automatically when you do them.
For example, if you commit to GitHub, play a game of chess, do a LeetCode problem, it can update your habit automatically. You can connect other apps with the use of the API or chrome extension.

It's designed for musicians, composers and producers - typically people involved with film/TV/game scoring or ambient music. I open-sourced it primarily because I'm very fond of this philosophy and I want to open the door for serving a wider audience than just my own libraries.

I originally built ScriptSpool because I wanted to make short code animations for my own development tutorials.

items.title: AI agents that pass authentication can still drift, expose data, or get memory-poisoned
items.contentSnippet:
